relationship_to_original_hypothesis.rule: this contract does not rescue or replace the failed original 6/8 generality test; it defines a new hypothesis generated by the frozen heterogeneity result

observation_process.note: simple density-dependent single-catch selection reproduced support decline but not the observed W or Delta magnitudes

future_response.source: first NEON small-mammal observations not contained in RELEASE-2026
future_response.observation_process: copy the exact three-night, standard-grid, target-taxonomy, completeness, saturation, m>=5, genus-MNKA and metric rules unchanged unless NEON changes the protocol before response access; any protocol adaptation must be documented before future W/B are opened

packing_mode.development_basis: multi-site, >=30 sessions, positive Delta, W<0, B>=0, raw-B same sign, every leave-one-site-out Delta positive

footprint_compression_mode.development_basis: multi-site, >=30 sessions, negative Delta, W<0, B<0, raw-B same sign, every leave-one-site-out Delta negative

future_directional_predictions.beta_W: descriptive; no directional confirmation requirement because site-level W stability was weaker than B/Delta

excluded_from_mode_confirmation.Microtus: Delta positive but leave-one-site-out sign not stable and W/B both positive in development data
excluded_from_mode_confirmation.Napaeozapus: one site, eight sessions, raw-B and debiased-B Delta signs disagree
excluded_from_mode_confirmation.Onychomys: one site only despite large positive development Delta

primary_future_tests.name: packing_mode_directional_replication
primary_future_tests.rule: for each of Chaetodipus, Myodes and Peromyscus, future beta_delta > 0; at least 2/3 must also satisfy beta_W < 0 and beta_B >= 0
primary_future_tests.success: all three future beta_delta estimates > 0 and at least two show the strong-form sign pair

primary_future_tests.name: footprint_compression_directional_replication
primary_future_tests.rule: for each of Dipodomys and Sigmodon, future beta_delta < 0 and beta_B_debiased < 0
primary_future_tests.success: both genera satisfy both negative-direction predictions

primary_future_tests.name: mode_separation
primary_future_tests.rule: genus-balanced mean future beta_delta of packing genera exceeds genus-balanced mean future beta_delta of footprint-compression genera
primary_future_tests.success: difference > 0 under the frozen fixed-effects estimator

falsification.packing_mode_fails_if: two or more of the three packing genera have future beta_delta <= 0
falsification.footprint_compression_mode_fails_if: either Dipodomys or Sigmodon has future beta_delta >= 0 or beta_B_debiased >= 0
no_posthoc_rescue: add Microtus, Napaeozapus or Onychomys to improve success
change abundance proxy after response access
change m threshold after response access
introduce territoriality/sociality/habitat traits as a rescue of failed directional predictions

mechanistic_extension_boundary.future_trait_test: may be separately preregistered before future response access, but is not part of this directional mode confirmation contract
